Home/ Home Evaluation

What an Evaluation Includes

A real review,
not a robot estimate

  • ✓
    A personal review of your homeIts size, condition, updates, and the features buyers look for.
  • ✓
    Local market contextWhat similar homes near you have been asking and selling for.
  • ✓
    Plain-language next stepsWhat to fix, what to skip, and how to prepare if you decide to sell.

How it works: Send a note through the Contact page and choose “Free Home Evaluation.” I'll follow up personally to discuss your home and your options.

Request a Free Evaluation

01

You reach out

One short note through the Contact page — your name, your community, and anything you'd like me to know about your home.

02

We talk about your home

A personal conversation about its size, condition, updates and features — and what's happening on streets like yours.

03

You get clear next steps

An honest picture of where your home sits in today's market, plus practical preparation advice — whether you sell now, later, or not at all.

Is the evaluation really free? +

Yes — free and with no obligation. It's a conversation about your home and your options, not a commitment to list with me.

Why no instant online estimate? +

Automated estimates can't see your updates, your lot, or your street. A personal review is slower — and far more honest. No price estimate is given on this website itself.

I'm not sure I'm selling. Can I still ask? +

Absolutely. Many people ask simply to plan ahead. You'll get the same careful review either way.

Where I Work — Barrie & Simcoe County

Seven communities,
one home turf.

The streets, schools and neighbourhoods my clients call home — from the Kempenfelt Bay waterfront to the shores of Georgian Bay.

Home/ Areas

01 — The Hub

Barrie

On Kempenfelt Bay — downtown, waterfront trails, established east-end streets and newer south-end neighbourhoods, with GO train access to Toronto.

  • Waterfront
  • Downtown
  • East & South End
  • GO Transit

02 — Lakeside Living

Innisfil

Alcona, Cookstown and the Lake Simcoe shoreline — small-town centres, Friday Harbour resort living, and room for families to grow.

  • Alcona
  • Cookstown
  • Friday Harbour
  • Lake Simcoe

03 — Country Between Cities

Oro-Medonte

Rural roads, larger lots and trail country between Barrie, Orillia and Georgian Bay — privacy with city access in both directions.

  • Large Lots
  • Trails
  • Horseshoe Valley
  • Rural Homes

04 — The Sunshine City

Orillia

Between Lakes Simcoe and Couchiching — a historic downtown, waterfront parks and established, year-round neighbourhoods.

  • Two Lakes
  • Historic Downtown
  • Waterfront Parks

05 — Georgian Bay

Wasaga Beach

Georgian Bay and the world's longest freshwater beach — cottages, four-season recreation and year-round homes alike.

  • The Beach
  • Cottages
  • Year-Round Homes
  • Georgian Bay

06 — Villages & Woodlots

Springwater

Elmvale, Midhurst and Minesing — wooded lots, villages and countryside just west of Barrie, with Snow Valley skiing nearby.

  • Elmvale
  • Midhurst
  • Minesing
  • Snow Valley

07 — Close-Knit & Calm

Essa

Angus, Thornton and surrounding towns — a slower, close-knit pace within easy reach of Barrie and CFB Borden.

  • Angus
  • Thornton
  • Near CFB Borden
